page.overview:
Who is Abby?

Abby is a major character in To Be Beautiful, the second story from Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit. She is Sarah's best friend who gets increasingly concerned the more obsessed Sarah becomes with her appearance.

Abby wears her hair in braids and wears gold wire-framed glasses, much like how she did when she was younger. Nowadays, she has braces on her teeth and is a few inches taller. Sarah sees potential for beauty in Abby with her flawless coffee-with-cream (brown) complexion, her startling hazel eyes, and her graceful, slender body. However, she tends to wear baggy clothes. At the start of the story, Abby wears a hideous poncho and a long, loose floral-print skirt. Later, she wears gray sweatpants with a bulky purple sweater. At the end of the story, she’s wearing pink overalls.

Abby is said to be nice, smart, and straightforward. Sarah calls her a lovable nerd, as she wants to be a scientist and is always making theories. Abby also likes to joke around and is somewhat childish, which can make her stubborn at times. Unlike Sarah, Abby isn't preoccupied with beauty and doesn't have much interest in fashion, instead focusing on more educational matters. She says that she doesn't judge others based on their looks or their money, although she makes fun of the Beautifuls' outfits and calls them empty-headed.

Sarah and Abby have been best friends since kindergarten. When they were little, the two had pink carrying cases filled with Barbies and their various clothes and accessories. They would take turns carrying their cases to each other's houses and playing for hours, only stopping for juice box and graham cracker breaks. Abby tended to experiment on her Barbies, shaving one bald and coloring the hair of another's green with a Magic Marker to make her look like a crazy supervillain. The two also played with finger paint and Play-Doh.
